Standard and Accessibility Extra Extra Large with Increased Contrast captures preserve readable hierarchy, full scroll reachability, and final-row clearance above the dock. Reduce Motion was also live checked. Evidence: output/validation/ios-screens/accessibility/app-shell-standard.png, app-shell-axxlarge-contrast.png, and app-shell-axxlarge-bottom.png.
